guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 高拱壩與發電機額定量的辨識。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: High arch dam and generator rating interpretation. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 供應商記錄單部發電機額定855.6MVA為視在功率
2014 年官方紀錄：六月全廠併網，與單部機組較早測試節點分開
假想教材：視在容量與無功；S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar
假想教材：風機轉速與耗能；P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW
假想教材：定子銅損邊界；Iphase=24000 A; Rphase=0.0007 ohm; Pcu=3*Iphase*Iphase*Rphase/1e6=1.2096 MW
factsEn: The supplier records 855.6 MVA apparent power for a rated generator example
2014 official record: Full plant grid connection occurs in June, distinct from earlier individual-unit testing
Hypothetical teaching: Apparent capacity and reactive power; S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar
Hypothetical teaching: Rotor rotational stored energy; J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ
Hypothetical teaching: Fan speed and power; P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW
Hypothetical teaching: Stator copper loss boundary; Iphase=24000 A; Rphase=0.0007 ohm; Pcu=3*Iphase*Iphase*Rphase/1e6=1.2096 MW
timeline: 1987　墾務局監測手冊出版，這是參考文獻年代而非本壩施工年份
2014　六月全廠併網，與單部機組較早測試節點分開
2026　本課核對公開來源並重算原創假想模型，屬教材修訂日期
timelineEn: 1987 — Reclamation instrumentation manuals are published; this dates references rather than construction of this dam
2014 — Full plant grid connection occurs in June, distinct from earlier individual-unit testing
2026 — This course verifies public references and recomputes original hypothetical models, a curriculum revision date
codes: 美國墾務局大壩監測手冊，混凝土或土石壩依型式選讀
美國墾務局小壩設計手冊，僅作方法比較而非大型工程核准準則
codesEn: Reclamation Dam Instrumentation Manuals, select concrete or embankment according to dam type
Reclamation Design of Small Dams, comparative methods rather than approval criteria for this major project
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：溪洛渡水壩
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Xiluodu Dam
guides.concept: 溪洛渡案例從發電機視在功率與實功區分開始，接續冷卻、轉速、轉矩與振動，再回到拱壩變形、水力消能及梯級調度。學員須追蹤每筆資料的量測邊界，說明同一數值在設備銘牌、瞬時測試和年度電量中具有不同意義，避免由規模推定性能。
guides.conceptEn: The Xiluodu case starts by distinguishing apparent and active generator power, then studies cooling, speed, torque and vibration before returning to arch deformation, dissipation and cascade scheduling. Learners track measurement boundaries and explain why a number on a rating plate, during a test and in annual energy accounting means different things.
procedure: 溪洛渡供應商資料中的兆伏安額定值提醒學員，發電機電流容量同時支援實功與無功。功率三角形以平方和關聯三者，不能把視在功率減實功當無功。教材只在平衡正弦穩態下求尺度，實際勵磁、定子電流及端部發熱限制需要能力曲線。 功率三角形的無功大小仍需配合符號慣例，供應與吸收可有相同幅值，卻對電壓控制造成不同作用。
水輪發電機轉子儲存的旋轉動能可在短時間功率不平衡時交換，但不是可持續供電的水庫能量。轉動慣量乘角速度平方的一半給出動能，若轉速變化小，能量變化仍與初始速度有關。教材用整體等效慣量建立尺度，不推定實際機組慣量常數。 可釋放動能是兩個轉速狀態的能量差，若只用總動能估算支援時間，就等於假設轉子可停轉。
發電機通風增加時，風機相似律可估算相同幾何及相似工況下的流量、壓升和軸功率變化。功率對轉速約呈三次方，因此小幅提速可能增加顯著輔機耗能。相似律需配合系統阻力曲線，風道變更、失速或密度改變都可能破壞簡化比例。 風機功率相似通常指軸端，變頻器與馬達損失要另列，才能與電端輔機耗電建立一致比較。
定子繞組的電阻損失與電流平方成正比，且電阻會隨溫度上升。教材以每相有效電阻與相電流計算三相損失，必須先辨認接法及所給電流定義。交流附加損失、鐵損與機械損失不在此式中，不能將三相銅損誤當成發電機全部損失。 每相有效電阻需和電流頻率及溫度相符，直流電阻只提供部分基礎，不能自動涵蓋所有交流附加效應。
潤滑油除了傳熱也暫存熱量，因此負載突變後的油溫會有延遲。以油量、比熱與溫升估算顯熱可幫助檢查短時能量帳，但循環中的熱交換器、軸承金屬及管路也會儲熱。單一混合槽模型只代表平均油溫，不能推定軸瓦接觸面的最高溫度。 熱容量只改變升溫時間尺度，長時間穩態仍需足夠散熱能力，增加油量不能永久抵消持續熱負荷。
蓄水後兩岸變形會改變谷幅，但距離縮短可能來自一岸、兩岸或測量基準移動。教材把兩點間距變化除初始距離表示平均幾何應變尺度，不把它當成岩體各處的局部應變。需保留左右岸絕對位移與方向，才能把谷幅反應連結到拱座相容條件。 兩點距離只提供沿連線方向的投影，垂直於連線的共同位移可能幾乎看不到，需要完整三維控制網。
理想平行板裂隙的層流導水能力與開度三次方成正比，因此很小的開度變化也可能明顯改變流量。教材使用光滑固定開度及牛頓流體，將壓差、黏度與流路長度列明；天然裂隙粗糙、接觸及網絡分岔會改變此關係，不能用流量唯一反推幾何。 流路長度與開度可能互相補償產生相同流量，反算參數具有非唯一性，需要獨立幾何或示蹤資料縮小範圍。
地下廠房及廊道通風包含彎頭、格柵和分支等局部阻力，壓損與動壓及阻力係數相關。教材以一個已知係數估算局部壓損，提醒學員係數的參考速度必須明確。這只是正常通風能量帳，不代表火災煙控、逃生條件或所有分支風量均已驗證。 阻力係數使用的參考速度可能位於不同斷面，串接多構件時應換成一致能量帳，不能直接加不相容的係數。
同一水量通過上下游兩座電站，可利用兩段不同的落差，並非創造新的水量或把同一位能重複計算。教材以同一流量乘各段淨水頭效率相加求總功率，先確認兩段高程落差不重疊。實際河道傳播、支流與水庫儲存會使兩站瞬時流量不同。 上下游兩段效率各自作用於各段位能，不應把效率連乘套在總落差，因第一段損失不會消滅下游全部落差。
增加機組流量會提高水力輸入，也可能增加與流量平方相關的引水損失，因此每增加一單位流量得到的功率不是固定值。教材對含損失的功率式微分，區分平均功率除流量與邊際增益。這個局部分析仍需效率及運轉區域限制，不能作無約束最佳化命令。 損失項隨流量平方增加，功率中的該項則隨流量三次方，因此微分後會出現三倍係數，不能漏算。
procedureEn: The supplier MVA rating illustrates that generator current capacity supports both active and reactive power. Their power triangle uses a sum of squares; reactive power is not apparent power minus active power. The calculation applies to balanced sinusoidal steady state, while excitation, stator current and end-region heating require an actual capability curve. Reactive magnitude from the triangle still needs a sign convention; supply and absorption can share magnitude while having different consequences for voltage control at the connection.

Rotor kinetic energy can exchange during brief power imbalance but is not sustained reservoir generation. Half the inertia times angular speed squared gives stored energy, with small energy changes still dependent on initial speed. An assumed equivalent inertia establishes scale without claiming the actual machine inertia constant or allowable speed excursion. Available kinetic release is the energy difference between two speeds; using total stored energy for support duration implicitly assumes that the rotor can stop completely.

Fan affinity laws estimate changes in flow, pressure and shaft power for unchanged geometry and similar conditions. Power varies approximately with the cube of speed, so a modest increase can raise auxiliary demand substantially. System resistance must also be considered; duct changes, stall and density variation can invalidate the simplified ratio. Fan power similarity usually refers to shaft power; converter and motor losses need separate terms before comparison with electrical auxiliary demand is physically consistent.

Stator resistive loss scales with current squared and resistance increases with temperature. Calculate three-phase loss using effective per-phase resistance and phase current, first identifying winding connection and current definition. Additional AC, iron and mechanical losses remain outside this equation, so copper loss is not the entire generator loss account. Effective per-phase resistance must match temperature and frequency; a DC resistance measurement supplies only part of the basis and does not automatically include all AC effects.

Lubricating oil transports and temporarily stores heat, producing a delayed temperature response after a load change. Oil mass, heat capacity and rise estimate sensible storage, while exchangers, bearing metal and piping also store heat. A mixed-tank model describes mean oil temperature rather than the maximum temperature at the bearing contact. Heat capacity changes the heating time scale, while long-term steady operation still needs adequate heat removal; adding oil cannot indefinitely offset a continuous thermal load.

Reservoir filling can change valley width through movement of either bank, both banks or the measurement reference. Distance change divided by initial separation gives a mean geometric strain scale, not local strain everywhere in the rock. Absolute movement and direction on each side are needed to connect closure to abutment compatibility. Two-point distance supplies a projection along the line; shared movement perpendicular to it can remain almost invisible, requiring a complete three-dimensional control network.

Laminar conductance of an ideal parallel-plate fracture varies with aperture cubed, making small opening changes important. State smooth fixed aperture, Newtonian viscosity, pressure difference and path length. Roughness, contacts and network branching alter natural fractures, so measured flow does not uniquely determine the physical aperture of a real seepage path. Path length and aperture can compensate to produce the same flow, making inverse estimates nonunique; independent geometry or tracer evidence is needed to constrain them.

Underground powerhouse ventilation includes local losses at bends, screens and branches, related to dynamic pressure and a loss coefficient. One assumed coefficient estimates local pressure loss, with its reference velocity explicitly stated. This normal-ventilation account does not verify smoke control, escape conditions or flow distribution through every branch of the network. Loss coefficients may use velocities at different sections; connecting several fittings requires a consistent energy account rather than directly adding coefficients with incompatible reference velocities.

The same water can generate through two successive drops without creating water or counting one potential-energy drop twice. Sum each net-head and efficiency contribution at a common assumed discharge, confirming that the elevation intervals do not overlap. Routing, tributaries and storage can make actual instantaneous discharges differ between plants. Each efficiency acts on its own potential-energy drop; multiplying efficiencies over total head misrepresents the stages, because losses upstream do not eliminate the downstream drop.

Increasing turbine flow raises hydraulic input while also increasing conveyance losses that may scale with flow squared. Marginal power is therefore not constant. Differentiate a loss-inclusive power equation and distinguish its derivative from average power divided by discharge. Efficiency variation and operating-region limits remain necessary before any optimization interpretation. Head loss grows with flow squared, but its contribution within power grows with flow cubed; differentiation therefore introduces a factor of three that must be retained.
evidence: 固定視在容量並增加實功，計算剩餘無功尺度，畫出兩個工作點，再說明為何真正可用無功仍可能受勵磁或冷卻限制。
將轉速降低百分之一，計算可釋出的動能而非總動能，再除以假想功率缺口估算短時尺度，列出此估算忽略的控制作用。
對三種轉速比例計算功率及理想風量比例，畫出耗能增幅，並指出若系統阻力增加時需要重新量測哪個工作點。
固定電阻把電流提高兩成，重算銅損，再增加熱態電阻比例，分別比較兩項效應並列出現地熱量帳還缺少的損失來源。
在相同熱輸入下比較兩種油量的初期升溫速率，再加入金屬熱容量，說明需哪些溫度測點才能區分儲熱與散熱不足。
evidenceEn: Increase active power at fixed apparent capacity and calculate the remaining reactive scale. Plot both operating points and explain why actual reactive capability may still be constrained by excitation or cooling.

Reduce speed by one percent and calculate released rather than total kinetic energy. Divide it by an assumed power deficit to estimate a short time scale and list the control actions omitted by that estimate.

Calculate power and ideal airflow ratios for three speed ratios and plot the demand increase. Identify the operating point that must be remeasured if system resistance changes after maintenance or duct modification.

Increase current by twenty percent at fixed resistance and recalculate copper loss. Then increase hot resistance, compare both effects separately and list the remaining loss sources required by a field heat account.

Compare initial heating rates for two oil inventories under equal heat input, then add metal heat capacity. Identify temperature measurements that distinguish thermal storage from inadequate heat removal in the system.
pitfalls: 以視在減實功估算無功會破壞向量關係，造成錯誤容量判斷；若系統含顯著諧波，簡單三角形本身也可能不足，需明確區分基波及總功率定義。
在失速區增加轉速可能提高噪音與耗能卻不改善均勻通風；若馬達效率隨負載變化，軸功率相似也不會直接等於電端功率比例，需要分別量測。
油槽分層或旁通會使單點溫度低估高溫油區，油量不足又會縮短熱緩衝時間；如果只按穩態溫差分析，就可能漏掉短時供油中斷。
接觸點閉合與局部堵塞會使有效水力開度不同於量得的平均幾何開度；若溫度變化降低黏度，流量也會增加，不能把所有增流都認定為裂隙擴張。
將上游總落差再次列入下游水頭會重複計算位能，忽略流量延遲又會使逐時能量帳不閉合；兩者可能在月平均下被掩蓋，需保留分段基準。
pitfallsEn: Subtracting active from apparent power violates the vector relationship and misstates capacity. Significant harmonics can also make the simple triangle inadequate, requiring explicit distinction between fundamental-frequency and total-power definitions before interpreting the result.

Increasing speed in a stalled region can raise noise and demand without improving uniform ventilation. Changing motor efficiency also means shaft-power similarity does not directly establish the electrical-input ratio, which requires a separate measurement boundary.

Stratification or bypass can make one tank sensor understate a hot region, while low oil inventory reduces thermal buffering time. A steady-state temperature difference alone may therefore miss a brief interruption of supply to the bearing.

Contact closure and local blockage make hydraulic aperture differ from mean geometric aperture. Warming can also lower viscosity and increase flow, so every rise in seepage cannot be assigned to fracture enlargement without temperature and pressure evidence.

Including the upstream drop again in downstream head double-counts potential energy. Ignoring travel delay also disrupts hourly energy closure. Monthly averages can conceal both errors, so elevation references and interval boundaries must be retained for each stage.

related.title: 阿斯旺高壩
related.transfer: 可遷移「視在容量與無功」與「裂隙開度與滲流」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；阿斯旺高壩的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Apparent capacity and reactive power" and "Fracture aperture and flow" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Aswan High Dam must be respecified.

把本課算例的一個假設移到阿斯旺高壩，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「淤積量與乾密度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Apparent capacity and reactive power” and “Seasonal reservoir water balance”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Aswan High Dam, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Sediment storage and dry density", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 溪洛渡水壩
history.text: 供應商技術介紹記錄溪洛渡於二〇一四年六月全廠併網，並列十八部機組及十三點八六吉瓦名目裝機。文中單部發電機的八百五十五點六兆伏安是視在功率，不能當成相同數字的兆瓦。課程保留此單位辨識重點，不重複未獨立核對的減碳估算或世界排名。新增算例的功率因數與水力參數均為假設，歷史文獻年代及教材覆核日期亦與工程投產事件分開。
history.textEn: The supplier technical account records full Xiluodu grid connection in June 2014, eighteen units and 13.86 GW nominal installed capacity. Its 855.6 MVA generator figure is apparent power and cannot be relabeled as the same number of megawatts. The course retains that unit distinction without repeating unverified emissions estimates or world rankings. Power factors and hydraulic values in the new examples are assumptions, and literature dates and curriculum review remain separate from commissioning events.

history.textEn: The course turns "Apparent capacity and reactive power" through "Marginal power from added flow" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
